description: This Python source file defines a Content Filter Guardrail class for LiteLLM, which performs regex pattern matching, keyword filtering, and category-based content detection to block or mask sensitive content in text inputs and streaming responses. It includes logic for loading configurations, patterns, and categories, as well as applying content filtering actions and integration with LightLLM-specific utilities.

classes.name: CategoryConfig
classes.description: Configuration data structure for content categories, storing name, description, default action, keywords, and exceptions.

classes.name: ContentFilterGuardrail
classes.description: Main class implementing content filtering guardrail for LiteLLM, including methods for initialization, loading configurations, pattern matching, keyword filtering, masking, and integrating with streaming responses.

methods.name: None _load_categories(self, categories: List[ContentFilterCategoryConfig])
methods.description: Loads category configurations from provided list, reads their associated YAML files, and registers keywords with actions and severity thresholds.

methods.name: CategoryConfig _load_category_file(self, file_path: str)
methods.description: Reads a YAML file to create a CategoryConfig object with description, default action, keywords, and exceptions.

methods.name: bool _should_apply_severity(self, severity: str, threshold: str)
methods.description: Determines if a given severity level meets the threshold for filtering based on severity order.

methods.name: None _add_pattern(self, pattern_config: ContentFilterPattern)
methods.description: Compiles and registers a regex or prebuilt pattern for later matching in input texts.

methods.name: None _load_blocked_words_file(self, file_path: str)
methods.description: Loads blocked words and their actions from a YAML file and updates the internal blocked words dictionary.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[str,str,ContentFilterAction]] _check_patterns( self, text: str )
methods.description: Checks input text against all compiled regex patterns, returning matches with pattern name and action.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[str,str,str,ContentFilterAction]] _check_category_keywords( self, text: str, exceptions: List[str] )
methods.description: Searches input text for category keywords, considering exceptions and severity thresholds, and returns matching keyword, category, severity, and action.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[str,ContentFilterAction,Optional[str]]] _check_blocked_words( self, text: str )
methods.description: Checks input text for blocked keywords and returns matches with action and description.

methods.name: str _filter_single_text(self, text: str)
methods.description: Performs category keyword, regex pattern, and blocked word checks on a single piece of text; raises HTTPException if a BLOCK action is triggered or masks text if masker is specified.

methods.name: str _mask_content(self, text: str, pattern_name: str)
methods.description: Produces masked content string based on pattern name.

methods.name: "GenericGuardrailAPIInputs" apply_guardrail( self, inputs: "GenericGuardrailAPIInputs", request_data: dict, input_type: Literal["request", "response"], logging_obj: Optional["LiteLLMLoggingObj"] = None, )
methods.description: Main method to process a batch of texts, applying filtering and masking; also processes images if configured.
